verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships official SDKs in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, .NET and Java, with equal access to all Registry providers. Its Automation API lets you use the Pulumi engine itself as an SDK to create, update and destroy infrastructure programmatically. Community users independently confirm building with the TypeScript SDK and its typing, and praise the Automation API. Missing for 10: evidence of an official SDK or OpenAPI spec for the Pulumi Cloud REST API (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and several users criticize the SDK and provider documentation quality.
